The employee and coworker were going to lunch when the employee fell off the tractor. The employee was crushed in the upper right chest area and head and killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when scaffold collapses
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: File Llp. Rio Rancho, NM. At 1:00 p.m. on August 18, 2015, an employee was working on a scaffold building a masonry wall. The scaffold collapsed and the employee fell to the ground and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when a scaffold collapses
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Mccarthy Construction. Rio Rancho, NM. On August 18, 2015, an employee is killed when a scaffold collapse. No specific details were given about the accident or the injury of the employee.

events.title: Employee Is Crushed By Falling Roller And Later Dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: New Image Construction. Las Vegas, NM. At approximately 2:00 p.m. on April 13, 2015, Employee #1 was loading a roller onto a flatbed trailer by driving it up the ramp. When he was loading the roller, it tipped over the side of the trailer. Employee #1 jumped off of the roller but the roller fell on top of him.
